prompt: Low angle close on churned mud beside a road, many small bare footprints overlapping in a wide trail leading away from the road toward a hillside, rain filling them
motion: Rain slowly fills the prints. The camera drifts along the trail toward the hill.
say: And the trail went off the road, up the hill, in the wrong direction entirely. Which is when Miriel said the thing that decided the next three days.
sfx: Rain on mud, wind, distant water
